jobs.title: IT Program Manager, Staff - ERP Transformation
jobs.location: San Diego, California, United States of America
jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Incorporated
Job Area:
Information Technology Group, Information Technology Group > IT Program Management
General Summary:
The Staff IT Program Manager will lead the planning and execution of Qualcomm’s enterprise ERP transformation, a multi-year initiative to modernize core business processes and transition to a scalable, cloud-based, AI-enabled ERP platform. The role will coordinate business and IT workstreams spanning finance, accounting, supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, data, integrations, security, testing, cutover, and organizational change. The Program Manager will establish integrated governance, plans, budgets, dependencies, decision forums, and outcome measures; direct delivery across internal teams, software vendors, and systems integrators; and provide transparent reporting to executive sponsors and steering committees. This role reports to the Office of Planning & Delivery (OPD), part of the Office of the CIO (OCIO).

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Leads the full lifecycle of a large, global, cross-functional ERP transformation from strategy and business case through design, build, testing, deployment, stabilization, and value realization.
- Builds and maintains an integrated, outcome-based transformation roadmap and plan of record covering business process, application, data, integration, infrastructure, security, controls, organizational change, deployment, and operational readiness.
- Establishes the program governance model, decision rights, workstream structure, delivery methodology, and executive reporting cadence; facilitates steering committee, program leadership, design authority, dependency, risk, and decision forums.
- Partners with executive sponsors, business process owners, and IT leaders across finance, accounting, supply chain, manufacturing, procurement, commercial operations, data, architecture, security, and infrastructure to define the transformation vision, scope, deployment strategy, business case, measurable outcomes, and accountabilities.
- Coordinates objective, business-led Oracle Cloud ERP and SAP S/4HANA platform assessments, proofs of concept, fit-to-standard activities, architecture reviews, solution design, implementation planning, and vendor recommendations.
- Drives timely enterprise design decisions and global process harmonization, including chart of accounts, master data, integrations, reporting, controls, historical data, deployment sequencing, legal-entity and regional requirements, compliance, and business continuity.
- Manages interdependencies across ERP workstreams and adjacent platforms and owns consolidated scope, schedule, budget, resources, quality, risks, issues, assumptions, dependencies, milestones, critical-path activities, changes, decisions, and actions.
- Directs integrated data, integration, and testing readiness, including ownership, quality thresholds, cleansing, mapping, reconciliation, mock conversions, controls, cutover validation, and functional, integration, regression, performance, security, user acceptance, and operational testing.
- Integrates stakeholder engagement, communications, training, organizational readiness, adoption, and sustained process change into the transformation plan.
- Leads deployment, cutover, business-continuity preparation, command-center readiness, go-live governance, hypercare, stabilization, and transition to the future ERP product, platform, and support operating model, including clear service ownership, governance, support processes, and continuous-improvement mechanisms.
- Directs systems integrators, software providers, consultants, and other partners; coordinates workforce planning and reviews statements of work, staffing models, estimates, deliverables, acceptance criteria, commercial commitments, invoices, performance, and change requests.
- Establishes the benefits-realization framework by defining financial and non-financial baselines, target outcomes, measures, timing, and accountable business owners; monitors value throughout delivery and ensures post-deployment tracking, corrective action, and sustained realization.
- Anticipates cross-workstream risks and resource constraints, escalates decision needs early, drives mitigation and recovery plans, and provides concise, fact-based executive communications on program health, options, tradeoffs, financial outlook, and business outcomes.
- Applies lessons learned and leading practices from prior ERP transformations and operates with substantial independence, executive presence, sound judgment, and the ability to influence outcomes without direct authority.

CORPORATE & PROFESSIONAL COMPETENCIES:
- Analytical Expertise - Analyzes, interprets, integrates, and verifies complex information from multiple sources to identify critical trends, make informed decisions, and address complex ERP transformation challenges.
- Clear Communication - Communicates complex program information accurately and promptly, adapting messages and methods to the evolving needs of executive, business, technical, and external audiences.
- Coaching & Development - Seeks feedback and continuous learning, provides leadership and constructive coaching to program participants, and aligns individual and team development with transformation and organizational goals.
- Collaborative Teamwork - Builds effective working relationships across functions, business units, geographies, and external partners while demonstrating and encouraging respect, dignity, and fairness.
- Functional Knowledge - Leverages advanced ERP and program-management expertise together with operational, financial, and organizational knowledge to create business cases, assess cost and value, and connect work across the enterprise.
- Impactful Innovation - Develops and implements impactful approaches, process improvements, solutions, and responsible AI-enabled opportunities for complex situations while encouraging alternative viewpoints that challenge ingrained practices.
- Strategic Execution - Prioritizes key objectives and manages complex, cross-functional work while meeting quality expectations, navigating ambiguity and shifting priorities, delivering commitments, and adhering to Qualcomm standards of ethical behavior.

MINIMUM QUALIFICATIONS:
- Bachelor's degree in Information Technology, Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, Business, Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, or a related field.
- 8+ years of program or project management experience, including leadership of large, complex, global technology or business transformation programs.
- Demonstrated experience managing at least one significant ERP implementation, migration, upgrade, or transformation through multiple lifecycle phases.
- Hands-on program leadership experience with Oracle ERP and/or SAP, including coordination of business process, application, data, integration, testing, deployment, and change workstreams.
- Experience managing multi-million-dollar budgets, business cases, systems integrators, software vendors, contracts, statements of work, and geographically distributed teams.
- Strong understanding of enterprise business processes such as record to report, procure to pay, order to cash, plan to produce, inventory, costing, and financial close.
- Ability to communicate with and influence executives, business process owners, architects, technical teams, finance partners, and external providers in a matrixed environment.
- Proven ability to create structure in ambiguity, manage complex dependencies, drive difficult decisions, and deliver measurable outcomes.

PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS:
- 10+ years of program management experience, including leadership of a multi-year, global ERP transformation.
- Hands-on program leadership experience across both Oracle and SAP ERP ecosystems, such as Oracle Cloud ERP or Oracle E-Business Suite and SAP S/4HANA or SAP ECC.
- Experience leading ERP platform evaluation, selection, fit-to-standard, global template, phased deployment, or coexistence strategies.
- Experience in the semiconductor, high-technology, electronics, manufacturing, or similarly complex global industry.
- Working knowledge of semiconductor or high-tech finance and supply-chain processes, including product costing, inventory valuation, manufacturing, planning, sourcing, logistics, and revenue operations.
- Experience with master data governance, data migration, enterprise integrations, controls, testing automation, cutover, and post-go-live stabilization.
- Experience establishing transformation governance and presenting recommendations, tradeoffs, and program health to senior executives and steering committees.
- Demonstrated organizational change management and business adoption experience for large-scale process and technology change.
- PMP, PgMP, SAP, Oracle, Prosci, SAFe, Scrum, or related certification.
- Master's degree in Business Administration, Information Systems, Engineering, Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, or a related field.

This is an office-based position located in San Diego, CA and is expected to comply with the company's onsite work policy.

This is a U.S. based position and is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Strategy and Business Operations Lead (IT Enterprise Data and Analytics)
jobs.location: San Diego, California, United States of America
jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Incorporated
Job Area:
Information Technology Group, Information Technology Group > IT Project Management
General Summary:
Serves as a strategy and operations leader and chief of staff to the VP of IT and the IT leadership team, driving the strategic agenda, operating cadence, and execution of high-priority initiatives across the organization. Acts as a trusted extension of the leader—translating strategy into actionable plans, orchestrating the leadership operating rhythm, and ensuring alignment, accountability, and follow-through across teams. Brings structure to ambiguous, cross-functional problems; synthesizes data and insights into executive-ready recommendations; and represents the leader's priorities in forums where direct presence isn't possible. Operates with a high degree of discretion, judgment, and confidentiality.

This role requires full-time onsite work in San Diego, CA (5 days per week).

**This role is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship.

Qualifications
- 8+ years of project/program management, business operations, or strategy work experience with a Bachelor's degree.

OR
- 10+ years of equivalent work experience without a Bachelor's degree.

- Proven ability and experience leading large-scale data and analytics transformation and migration at scale (required), specifically geared toward AI readiness.

- AI-enabled (required) — hands-on fluency with AI tools and a demonstrated ability to embrace, adopt, and continuously adapt to a rapidly evolving AI footprint.

Preferred Qualifications

- Master's degree (MBA or IT/business-related field).

- Prior experience in a chief of staff, strategy & operations, business operations, or PMO leadership role supporting senior executives.

- Hands-on experience managing data and AI projects and leading data/AI-driven transformation initiatives at scale.

- Knowledge of the semiconductor industry and enterprise IT functions.

- Strong financial, planning, and data analysis skills; proficiency with executive communications and presentation development (PowerPoint, Excel, BI tools).

- Exceptional written and verbal communication, stakeholder management, and influence skills.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities

- Drives the IT leadership operating cadence—staff meetings, leadership reviews, business reviews (MBR/QBR), offsites, and all-hands—including agendas, pre-reads, content, and follow-up on action items and decisions.

- Partners with the VP and leadership team to shape and operationalize strategy, including annual and quarterly planning, goal/OKR setting, and tracking progress against objectives.

- Leads and orchestrates high-priority, cross-functional strategic initiatives end to end—defining scope, milestones, owners, and success metrics, and driving them to completion.

- Leads change management and enablement to evolve the leadership team and broader IT organization into an AI-first / AI-native team—driving adoption, capability-building, and new ways of working.

- Leads change management, training, and enablement to drive adoption of new platforms and tools both internally across IT and with business partners—building capability and ensuring sustained usage and value realization.

- Owns resource planning and portfolio management—balancing capacity, priorities, and investments across the organization's initiatives, and providing leadership with visibility into the full portfolio.

- Supports leadership on the mobilization of data governance across the organization for trust, quality, and AI readiness.

- Establishes AI-first processes and mechanisms for tracking execution and operations against strategy, giving leadership real-time visibility into progress, performance, and outcomes.

- Synthesizes data, metrics, and qualitative inputs into clear, executive-ready briefings, recommendations, and decision support for the leader and leadership team.

- Develops executive communications—leadership presentations, organizational updates, talking points, and messaging—on behalf of the VP and the IT organization.

- Acts as a proxy and integrator across the leadership team, ensuring alignment, surfacing risks and dependencies early, and holding cross-functional owners accountable for commitments.

- Manages the operational health of the organization—supporting budget and headcount planning, resource and vendor coordination, and tracking of key operating metrics.

- Drives organizational and team health initiatives, including engagement, culture, talent, and recognition programs in partnership with HR and leadership.

- Builds strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders across IT and business functions to enable collaboration and remove barriers to execution.

- Proactively identifies gaps, inefficiencies, and improvement opportunities in how the leadership team operates, and implements processes and mechanisms to address them.

- Operates at speed and continuously finds newer, smarter ways to drive speed and efficiency—challenging the status quo and accelerating how the organization plans, decides, and executes.

- Handles sensitive and confidential information with sound judgment, discretion, and professionalism.

Level of Responsibility

- Working independently with minimal supervision, exercising significant judgment in ambiguous situations.

- Taking responsibility for own work and making decisions with significant impact on the leadership team's effectiveness, the organization's priorities, and the ability to meet objectives.

- Using verbal and written communication skills to convey complex and/or detailed information to multiple audiences with differing knowledge levels; role requires strong negotiation, influence, and communication to senior leaders and large groups.

- Having significant influence over how the leadership team operates and over key organizational decisions and priorities.

- Using deductive and inductive problem solving across incomplete or conflicting information; advanced data analysis and synthesis skills are required.

- Exercising creativity to design new processes and mechanisms without established objectives or known parameters.

- Regularly participates in strategic planning affecting the broader organization.

jobs.title: IT Program Manager, Staff - Enterprise Data Transformation
jobs.location: San Diego, California, United States of America
jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Incorporated
Job Area:
Information Technology Group, Information Technology Group > IT Program Management
General Summary:
The Staff IT Program Manager will lead the planning and execution of Qualcomm’s enterprise data transformation, a multi-year initiative to establish the Enterprise Data Hub (EDH) as a unified, trusted, scalable, and governed foundation for enterprise data products, analytics, reporting, applications, and advanced technology solutions. The role will coordinate business and technology workstreams spanning data strategy, architecture, Databricks platform development, data engineering, data integration, migration, governance, quality, security, analytics, organizational change, adoption, and legacy-system retirement. The Program Manager will establish integrated governance, roadmaps, plans, budgets, dependencies, decision forums, and outcome measures; direct delivery across internal teams, software providers, systems integrators, and business functions; and provide transparent reporting to executive sponsors and steering committees. The role will ensure that enterprise data capabilities align with and support major business platforms and transformations, including CRM, HCM, ERP, PLM, supply chain, finance, customer, product, engineering, and other systems of record. This role reports to the Office of Planning & Delivery (OPD), part of the Office of the CIO (OCIO).

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES:
- Leads the full lifecycle of a large, global, cross-functional enterprise data transformation from strategy and business case through platform development, data onboarding, migration, solution delivery, deployment, adoption, operationalization, and value realization.
- Builds and maintains an integrated, outcome-based transformation roadmap and plan of record covering EDH platform evolution, Databricks capabilities, data architecture, data engineering, data products, integrations, governance, security, analytics, migration, legacy retirement, organizational change, and operational readiness.
- Establishes the program governance model, decision rights, workstream structure, delivery methodology, and executive reporting cadence; facilitates steering committee, program leadership, architecture, data governance, dependency, risk, and decision forums.
- Partners with executive sponsors, business data owners, product owners, enterprise architects, and IT leaders across finance, sales, supply chain, manufacturing, human resources, product development, engineering, commercial operations, security, infrastructure, analytics, and other functions to define the transformation vision, scope, business outcomes, delivery priorities, and accountabilities.
- Directs the development and evolution of EDH as the enterprise platform for governed data products, business intelligence, self-service analytics, enterprise applications, data sharing, and advanced analytical capabilities.
- Coordinates Databricks platform strategy and implementation, including lakehouse and medallion architecture, scalable ingestion and transformation pipelines, batch and streaming patterns, data sharing, workspace and environment strategy, observability, performance, cost management, release management, and platform operations.
- Drives enterprise data architecture and design decisions involving common data models, primary and master data, metadata, semantic layers, lineage, data contracts, retention, lifecycle management, interoperability, and secure access.
- Ensures data governance is embedded throughout the transformation, including data ownership and stewardship, quality and certification, cataloging, lineage, privacy, security, regulatory compliance, retention, and auditable controls.
- Maintains an end-to-end view of critical enterprise data flows, including data origination, transformation, enrichment, distribution, consumption, and control points across systems.
- Leads data discovery and intake processes that translate business needs, pain points, analytical requirements, and strategic priorities into defined data products, use cases, and platform capabilities.
- Establishes data classification and certification practices, including heightened quality, security, reconciliation, and approval requirements for critical, regulated, financial-reporting, and executive-decision datasets.
- Partners with architecture and engineering leaders to establish reference architectures, reusable patterns, engineering standards, and platform guardrails that improve scalability, interoperability, reliability, security, and delivery speed.
- Promotes DataOps and software-engineering practices across the platform, including version control, CI/CD, automated data testing, environment promotion, deployment controls, documentation, and production observability.
- Defines and monitors service-level objectives and operational measures for platform availability, pipeline reliability, data freshness, processing performance, incident response, recovery, and stakeholder support.

jobs.title: Treasury Manager – Capital Markets
jobs.location: San Diego, California, United States of America
jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Incorporated
Job Area:
Finance & Accounting Group, Finance & Accounting Group > Treasury Investment
General Summary:
***This position is NOT eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship.***
The Treasury Manager – Capital Markets will lead core capital markets workstreams and own Qualcomm’s investment portfolio strategy, partnering with senior Treasury leadership on financing, derivatives, liquidity, market intelligence, and executive-level decision support. The role requires strong judgment, cross-functional leadership, and the ability to translate complex market and financial analysis into practical recommendations.
This manager-level role is expected to manage complex projects, influence senior stakeholders, and coach analysts or rotational employees supporting Treasury priorities.
Key Responsibilities
Derivatives & Financial Risk Management
- Manage execution, documentation, controls, reporting, and post-trade oversight for FX and interest rate derivatives.
- Analyze FX, rates, liquidity, and portfolio risks; quantify sensitivities and recommend actions for leadership consideration.
- Partner with Accounting on hedge documentation, effectiveness analysis, quarter-end close support, and issue resolution.

Capital Markets, Forecasting & Bank Analytics
- Provide analysis of credit markets, interest rates, rating agency considerations, bank capacity, and funding conditions to support capital allocation, financing, refinancing, and investment decisions.
- Manage execution readiness and post-execution workstreams for CP and debt issuance, revolving credit facility support, liability management, rate locks, swaps, and related hedging activities.
- Prepare transaction materials, scenario analysis, economics comparisons, and recommendations for senior Treasury leadership and executive review.
- Own interest income and expense forecasting and variance analysis versus plan.
- Manage bank relationship analytics, wallet analysis, internal scorecards, market intelligence, and concise executive-ready updates.

Investments & Liquidity Portfolio Management
- Own investment portfolio strategy and execution, including cash deployment, liquidity segmentation, maturity planning, yield analysis, and return evaluation.
- Monitor portfolio exposures, ratings, duration, return, and counterparty concentration; escalate issues and recommend actions.

Leadership, Cross-Functional Partnership & Strategic Support
- Lead cross-functional projects with Tax, Legal, Accounting, FP&A, Treasury Operations, business units, banks, auditors, and advisors.
- Provide strategic analyses on capital return, investment alternatives, stress/scenario analysis, financing capacity, and liquidity optimization.
- Drive process improvement, automation, controls, and scalable reporting across investments, capital markets, and related Treasury processes.
- Coach analysts, rotational employees, and project contributors.

Qualifications & Experience
Required
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related field.
- 8+ years of progressive experience in Corporate Treasury, Investments, Capital Markets, Banking, Asset Management, or Corporate Finance, with ownership of investments and exposure to debt capital markets, derivatives, liquidity planning, and executive-level analysis.
- Advanced financial modeling, market data interpretation, portfolio analytics, scenario analysis, and recommendation development skills.
- Ability to communicate complex financial concepts clearly to senior and non-technical audiences and make persuasive recommendations.
- Demonstrated experience applying AI, workflow automation, analytics, and data platforms (e.g., agents, Copilot, n8n, Databricks, dashboarding solutions) to improve Treasury efficiency, controls, reporting, forecasting, and decision-making processes.
- Demonstrated ability to manage multiple complex projects, navigate ambiguity, and deliver under time-sensitive Treasury deadlines.

Preferred
- Master’s degree (MBA or MS Finance) or professional certification (CTP, CFA).
- 10+ years of relevant experience in Treasury, Investments, Capital Markets, Banking, Asset Management, or Corporate Finance.
- Experience supporting Treasury Operations and corporate insurance programs, including cash management, bank account administration, insurance renewals, broker and carrier relationships, risk assessments, claims coordination, and related compliance and reporting activities.
- Experience with Kyriba, FXall, Bloomberg, Clearwater, bank portals, etc.
- Working knowledge of hedge accounting, ASC 815, investment accounting, and fair value concepts.
- Experience leading public company debt issuance, investment portfolio operations, rating agency analysis, commercial paper issuance, revolving credit facilities, or large-scale financing workstreams.

Required

jobs.title: Business Operations Analyst – Datacenter Business Unit
jobs.location: San Diego, California, United States of America
jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
Job Area:
Operations Group, Operations Group > Business Operations
General Summary:
***This position is NOT eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship.***
The Business Operations Analyst will support the Datacenter Business Unit (BU) by driving operational efficiency, supporting planning processes, and enabling smooth execution across the AI Datacenter business from new product introduction (NPI) to mass production through end of life. This role will provide analytical and operational support across demand forecasting, Sales & Operations Planning (S&OP) workflows, capacity and supply tracking, post‑sales operations, KPI reporting and perform excess and obsolete (E&O) analysis. The analyst will work closely with cross-functional teams to help scale and streamline critical business processes.

The Person
We are seeking a proactive, detail-oriented analyst with strong organizational, analytical, and communication skills. The ideal candidate thrives in a dynamic environment and is eager to develop expertise in operations, planning, and business process optimization. A strong problem‑solving mindset and willingness to collaborate across teams is essential.

Key Responsibilities
- Analyze, reconcile, and publish monthly and periodic demand forecasts, including forecast changes, assumptions, backlog, customer demand, and supply signals.
- Manage and monitor supply-and-demand balances for Data Center products, identifying shortages, excess supply, capacity constraints, inventory risks, and required actions.
- Support product allocation and supply prioritization across customers, programs, products, and sites from NPI through mass production based on available supply and business priorities.
- Set up and maintain products, product hierarchies, configurations, lifecycle attributes, and planning parameters in systems used for demand forecasting and supply planning.
- Support NPI readiness and product lifecycle transitions, including demand loading, ramp assumptions, product substitutions and discontinuations and transition planning.
- Perform E&O analysis by reviewing demand, supply, inventory, backlog, and lifecycle data; identify root causes and recommend disposition or mitigation actions.
- Support business operations activities including planning cycles, operational reviews, and performance and inventory tracking for the Datacenter BU.

jobs.title: Senior Director, Program Management - Data Center Custom Silicon
jobs.location: San Diego, California, United States of America; Santa Clara, California, United States of America
jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
Job Area:
Engineering Services Group, Engineering Services Group > Program Management
General Summary:
The Qualcomm Data Center Custom Silicon Group is seeking a senior Program Management leader to lead the customer program management organization responsible for the world’s most complex custom silicon programs for hyperscale and strategic data center customers.

This leader will own the execution operating system for external custom silicon engagements, including customer commitment tracking, Plan of Record governance, program milestones, executive dashboards, risk management, cross-functional escalation, and delivery readiness from engagement approval through tapeout, bring-up, qualification, production ramp, and customer acceptance.

The role requires deep semiconductor program execution experience, strong executive communication, and the ability to drive alignment across Engineering, Product Management, Business Development, Sales, Operations, Supply Chain, Finance, Legal, Quality, and external customer stakeholders.

This is not a status-reporting role. This leader will be accountable for ensuring CSG has a clear, accurate, and actionable view of customer demand, committed deliverables, execution risks, required decisions, and overall program health.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities
- Lead the Custom Silicon Group Program Management organization responsible for external customer programs across hyperscaler and strategic data center accounts.
- Develop, define, and manage execution of program Plans of Record, including schedules, budgets, resources, deliverables, risks, milestones, and cross-functional dependencies.
- Own the CSG program execution cadence, including weekly program reviews, customer commitment reviews, risk reviews, escalation forums, and executive operating updates.
- Build and maintain executive dashboards for Data Center EVP, CEO, CFO, and senior leadership reviews, including program health, customer commitments, milestone status, demand gaps, resource constraints, top risks, and required decisions.
- Drive customer-demand execution governance by translating customer asks into committed scope, execution plans, constraints, risks, and decision points in partnership with Product Management, Business Development, Sales, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Legal.
- Establish a single source of truth for custom silicon program health across tapeout, bring-up, validation, qualification, production readiness, supply readiness, customer deliverables, and ramp execution.
- Partner with Product Management to manage requirement baselines, scope changes, customer-specific tradeoffs, reuse opportunities, and roadmap implications.
- Partner with Business Development and Sales to support pursuit-to-program handoff, customer commitment clarity, escalation preparation, and alignment between commercial expectations and execution reality.
- Partner with Engineering leaders to track technical readiness, design closure, verification progress, software/firmware dependencies, validation risks, post-silicon bring-up, and resource constraints.
- Partner with Operations, Supply Chain, Sourcing, Quality, and Manufacturing teams to track foundry, OSAT, packaging, test, yield, reliability, production ramp, and supply readiness risks.
- Partner with Finance to link program milestones, NRE, revenue timing, investment requirements, operating budgets, and financial risks for executive decision-making.
- Partner with Legal and commercial teams to ensure program deliverables, milestones, acceptance criteria, and contractual commitments are clear, executable, and tracked.
- Drive disciplined risk management, including early identification of schedule, scope, technical, supply, customer, commercial, and financial risks.
- Escalate issues in a timely and structured manner with clear options, tradeoffs, ownership, and recommended decisions.
- Standardize program management processes, dashboards, templates, operating reviews, and best practices across CSG customer programs.
- Develop and lead a team of Program Managers responsible for individual customer programs, ensuring consistent execution discipline, customer readiness, and leadership visibility.
- Represent CSG program execution status to internal executives and, where appropriate, directly to external customer stakeholders.

While there is a strong preference for this position to be based in San Diego, Qualcomm's Santa Clara office site can also be considered. This position is expected to comply with the Company's onsite work policy.

Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
• 10+ years of Program Management or related work experience.

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s degree in Engineering, Business, or related field.
- 20+ years of semiconductor, silicon, hardware or systems program management experience.
- Experience leading custom silicon, ASIC, SoC, AI accelerator, networking, switch, NIC, or data center infrastructure programs.
- 8+ years of experience leading complex cross-functional technical programs.
- 5+ years of people leadership experience, including managing senior program managers or technical program leaders.
- Experience with hyperscaler or large strategic customer programs.
- Strong understanding of silicon lifecycle execution, including architecture, design, verification, physical implementation, tapeout, silicon bring-up, validation, qualification, production readiness, and ramp.
- Experience with advanced process nodes, high-performance SoCs, high-speed interfaces, advanced packaging, HBM, networking silicon, or AI infrastructure products.
- Experience managing program execution tied to NRE, customer milestones, contractual deliverables, revenue timing, and production commitments.
- Demonstrated ability to build executive dashboards and communicate clearly with EVP, CEO, CFO, customer executive, and board-level audiences.
- Strong executive presence with ability to operate as a neutral execution leader across Product Management, Business Development, Sales, Engineering, Operations, Finance, and Legal.
- Experience defining program management operating models, stage gates, KPIs, risk management frameworks, and executive escalation mechanisms.

Key Success Measures
- Clear, accurate, and trusted executive view of CSG program health.
- On-time execution against committed customer milestones.
- Early identification and escalation of material risks.
- Improved clarity between customer demand, committed scope, execution feasibility, and business impact.
- Strong alignment across Engineering, Product Management, BD, Sales, Operations, Finance, Legal, and customers.
- Consistent program management discipline across all major custom silicon engagements.
- Reduced surprises in EVP / CEO / CFO reviews.
- Stronger customer confidence in Qualcomm’s ability to execute complex custom silicon programs.

Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is a senior semiconductor program leader who has managed complex external customer programs at scale. This person must be technical enough to challenge engineering execution plans, commercially aware enough to understand customer and financial commitments, and operationally disciplined enough to create a reliable execution control system.

This leader should be comfortable operating without direct authority over many matrixed functions while still driving accountability, decisions, and closure.

Qualcomm is seeking an experienced and highly motivated Security Hardware Program Manager to lead the planning, execution, and delivery of next-generation Security IP solutions across Qualcomm's SoC portfolio. This role will drive cross-functional execution of hardware security technologies that establish the foundation of Qualcomm's Root of Trust architecture, secure boot infrastructure, cryptographic accelerators, trusted execution environments, memory protection frameworks, and industry-leading security certification initiatives.

As a Security Hardware Program Manager, you will work closely with architects, RTL designers, verification teams, firmware developers, platform integration teams, product management, certification organizations, and SoC program leadership to ensure successful development and deployment of security technologies across multiple product generations.

The successful candidate will be responsible for providing operation and program management support to our Security IP development team including the following responsibilities:

Qualcomm's Datacenter products are designed to power large-scale AI and cloud deployments.
We are seeking an experienced Software Program Manager to lead Data Center SoC Software Development for next-generation server, AI, and networking products.
The role drives software planning, development, integration, validation, and release execution across architecture, silicon, firmware, embedded software, platform software, validation, and productization teams from concept through production.
The role requires driving end-to-end software readiness across architecture, silicon, firmware, platform software, validation, and productization organizations, ensuring alignment to silicon milestones, software release commitments, feature readiness, and overall product readiness objectives.

**This position is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship.**

**Position requires to be onsite in San Diego, 5 days week

The ideal candidate will possess:
- Strong experience leading complex Data Center SoC software development programs involving hardware-software co-development.
- Direct experience managing software execution for Data Center SoCs, CPUs, AI accelerators, networking silicon, server platforms, or equivalent semiconductor firmware and software development programs.
- Deep understanding of semiconductor product development lifecycles, including architecture, pre-silicon enablement, silicon bring-up, platform integration, validation, software readiness, and productization.

- Master's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
- 8+ years of Program Management, Engineering Management, Technical Leadership, or related experience in semiconductor product development.
- 5+ years managing software, firmware, or platform execution for semiconductor or SoC programs.
- Direct experience managing software execution for Data Center SoCs, CPUs, AI accelerators, networking silicon, server platforms, or equivalent semiconductor firmware and software development programs.
- Experience with ARM-based processors, server CPUs, AI accelerators, networking silicon, DPUs, NPUs, SmartNICs, or related Datacenter technologies.

- Experience presenting software readiness, program status, risks, dependencies, and execution plans to Director-level and executive leadership.

- Drive end-to-end execution of Data Center SoC software programs from architecture through production release.
- Lead software development and software readiness activities aligned to silicon and product milestones.
- Develop and manage integrated software Plans of Record, schedules, dependencies, execution milestones, and release plans.
- Coordinate execution across architecture, ASIC, firmware, embedded software, system software, platform software, validation, and productization teams.

- Lead software readiness reviews, milestone reviews, and executive program reviews.
- Drive software release planning, feature readiness, bring-up readiness, validation readiness, and production readiness.
- Establish execution frameworks supporting requirements traceability, software planning, release governance, and development lifecycle management.
- Provide executive visibility into software execution, key risks, dependencies, mitigation plans, and overall product readiness.
- Drive alignment across internal engineering teams and external ecosystem partners.

- Influences technical and business decisions affecting software readiness and product milestones.
- Communicates complex technical and program information to senior leadership and engineering stakeholders.
- Resolves ambiguous and highly complex cross-functional execution challenges.
- Operates with broad responsibility across software, firmware, platform, validation, and silicon development organizations.
- Exercises leadership across cross-functional teams to ensure predictable execution and milestone delivery.

- Bachelor's degree in Engineering, Computer Science, or related field.
- 4+ years of Program Management or related work experience.
- 8+ years of semiconductor, SoC, firmware, embedded software, system software, platform software, or related development experience.

About Qualcomm
Qualcomm relentlessly innovates transforming businesses, enriching lives and fortifying societies. Our solutions are pivotal in crafting a smarter, interconnected world. At Qualcomm, we're committed to engineering human progress by delivering intelligent computing everywhere. We're passionate about harnessing the power of technology to transform industries and improve lives. Our early career programs offer limitless opportunities for growth, mentorship, and meaningful work. JOB DESCRIPTION:
The Compensation Analyst, Staff supports Qualcomm's mergers and acquisitions activities as the primary area of responsibility while also contributing to broader Compensation initiatives as team bandwidth and business priorities allow. jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm India Private Limited
Job Area:
Legal Group, Legal Group > Compliance
Qualcomm Overview:
Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5Gs potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age - and this is where you come in.

General Summary:
Job Summary:

Qualcomm is seeking an experienced compliance investigator with a strong background in planning and conducting internal investigations relating to the protection of intellectual property and trade secrets, as well as other compliance related investigations, including fraud, kickbacks, and violation of corporate compliance policies. The candidate will work independently and as part of cross-functional teams and must be proactive, diligent, exercise excellent judgement, and understanding of risk-based balance of multiple corporate goals. We are looking for someone with substantial experience leading investigations for a publicly traded, multinational, from initial assessment through resolution (root cause analysis and remediation), including supporting privileged legal matters. This position requires effective collaboration with key stakeholders in Legal, IT, Global Security, and HR/ER, among others.

PRINCIPAL DUTIES AND RESPONSIBILITIES :

- Work independently and exercise sound judgment with little supervision.
- Monitor and track alleged mishandling or misuse of trade secrets and intellectual property.
- Triage incoming allegations, including review of, IT security alerts, network logs, assessing information sensitivity, and potential risk of ongoing or future harm.
- Conduct assigned investigations as directed by senior members of the compliance team, often in coordination IT, Global Security, and HR/ER.
- Prepare investigation plans, collect and review investigative materials, interview witnesses, coordinate forensic examinations of IT assets, prepare closing memoranda including root cause analysis, address remedial actions, and coordinate with management.
- Manages individual project priorities, deadlines, and deliverables. Monitor case progression and meet key milestones.
- Perform data analytics and prepare compliance communications for management and employees.
- Ensure data integrity, confidentiality, and chain‑of‑custody discipline for all technical evidence collected, with timely and accurate entry of findings into the investigation case management system.
- Make ethical and timely decisions, solicit guidance from members of the legal team and cross-functional partners and impacted business leaders.
- Collaborate with in-house and outside counsel in connection with litigated matters.
- Support compliance investigations into alleged violations of the Company Code of Business Conduct and attendant compliance policies.
- Prepare periodic reports and presentation materials and brief regional and global management.
- Contribute to the continuous improvement of company information protection procedures and initiatives, including identification of best practices.

SKILLS AND EXPERIENCE REQUIRED :
- Bachelor’s degree or international equivalent.
- Minimum of 8 years of experience, with at least 4 years of conducting internal investigations for a publicly traded global multinational.
- Experience with IT security, intellectual property, and trade secrets investigations.
- Extensive knowledge of investigative techniques and ability to assess matters relating to misuse or misappropriation of confidential information, including trade secrets and intellectual property.
- Strong understanding and documented prior experience with computer forensics, network security, data loss prevention tools, endpoint and device forensic, and security logs.
- Excellent investigative, drafting, negotiating, and communications skills.
- Strong analytical and problem-solving ability.

jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Incorporated
Job Area:
Operations Group, Operations Group > Procurement
General Summary:
The Manager, Procurement, Global Travel leads complex procurement, supplier management, and operational transformation initiatives supporting Qualcomm’s global corporate travel program. This role partners with internal stakeholders to identify business requirements, define service strategies, evaluate suppliers, negotiate commercial agreements, and manage supplier performance to deliver best value, operational efficiency, policy compliance, duty of care, and a high-quality traveler experience.

The Manager translates global travel strategy into scalable operational programs, sourcing strategies, technology improvements, and measurable outcomes. The role manages day-to-day supplier and program performance, leads strategic sourcing and transformation initiatives, and evaluates emerging capabilities, including artificial intelligence, automation, predictive analytics, and self-service technologies, that can improve how employees plan, book, and experience business travel.

This role requires full-time onsite work in San Diego, CA (5 days per week).

Preferred Qualifications:
- Master’s degree in Business, Supply Chain, Procurement, Finance, or a related field.
- 6+ years of progressive experience in Procurement, Strategic Sourcing, Corporate Travel, Travel Operations, Travel Technology, Employee Services, Supplier Management, or a related field.
- 3+ years of experience working in a large, global, matrixed organization.
- 2+ years of experience in a role requiring interaction with senior leadership, including Director-level stakeholders and above.
- 1+ year of experience in a technical or functional leadership role, with or without direct reports.
- 1+ year of experience managing operating budgets, project financials, travel spend, or supplier cost models.

Principal Duties and Responsibilities:
Strategic Sourcing & Category Management
- Support global travel sourcing initiatives, supplier selection, and category strategies that align with business objectives.
- Define business requirements, develop sourcing strategies, manage RFx processes, and negotiate commercial agreements.
- Utilize market intelligence, benchmarking, analytics, and cost modeling to drive sourcing decisions and optimize value.
- Monitor industry trends, emerging technologies, and supplier capabilities to support continuous program improvement.

Travel Program Operations & Service Delivery
- Manage global travel operations and supplier performance to ensure a consistent, traveler-focused experience.
- Manage traveler support, escalations, service recovery, and issue resolution across regions.
- Identify operational risks, traveler pain points, and process improvement opportunities while balancing cost, compliance, and duty of care.
- Provide guidance on complex operational issues and escalate significant risks as appropriate.

Program Transformation & Technology
- Drive travel program transformation initiatives, including process improvements, automation, AI, self-service, and technology enhancements.
- Develop business cases, implementation plans, and governance frameworks to support innovation and operational efficiency.
- Partner with stakeholders to implement new technologies while ensuring compliance with privacy, security, and enterprise requirements.
- Drive adoption of new tools and processes through effective change management and continuous improvement.

Supplier Performance & Contract Management
- Manage strategic supplier relationships throughout the contract lifecycle, from selection and implementation through ongoing governance.
- Establish performance metrics, service-level agreements, and supplier scorecards to measure and improve outcomes.
- Conduct supplier business reviews and drive corrective actions to ensure contractual commitments are achieved.
- Identify and mitigate commercial, operational, financial, and service-delivery risks.

Data Analytics & Executive Reporting
- Develop reporting, dashboards, and performance metrics to monitor travel spend, supplier performance, traveler experience, and policy compliance.
- Analyze operational and financial data to identify trends, savings opportunities, risks, and improvement priorities.
- Prepare executive-level recommendations, presentations, business reviews, and decision-support materials for senior leadership.
- Measure and report program performance against established objectives and key performance indicators.

Stakeholder Management & Leadership
- Partner with Procurement, Finance, Security, HR, Legal, Technology, and regional teams to deliver global travel program objectives.
- Lead cross-functional initiatives, stakeholder engagement, communications, and change-management activities.
- Translate strategic goals into executable plans, governance structures, and measurable outcomes.
- Coach and mentor team members while managing priorities across multiple projects and initiatives.

Level of Responsibility
- Works independently with limited supervision and exercises sound judgment in managing complex procurement, supplier, operational, and transformation activities.
- Provides supervision, coaching, and work direction to direct reports and junior team members, as applicable.
- Makes moderate-to-impactful decisions within the function, including decisions related to suppliers, sourcing strategies, negotiations, technology, service delivery, and project execution.
- Operates within prescribed departmental budget objectives and supports the effective management of travel-program costs, project financials, and supplier commitments.
- Has a moderate degree of influence over key organizational decisions and is consulted by senior leadership on supplier, sourcing, operational, and travel-program matters.
- Communicates complex or detailed information to audiences with differing levels of category, technical, financial, or operational knowledge.
- Uses strong negotiation, executive communication, presentation, and influencing skills with suppliers, cross-functional stakeholders, and senior leadership.
- Manages work in which tasks frequently do not have predefined steps and require the simultaneous use of commercial, operational, analytical, and stakeholder-management capabilities.
- Demonstrates substantial creativity in developing new processes, sourcing approaches, supplier solutions, technology use cases, service models, and work products within established guidelines.
- Applies deductive and inductive problem solving when information is missing or incomplete and evaluates multiple approaches to determine the best course of action.
- Participates in strategic planning within the assigned category or program area and influences immediate and longer-term operations.
- Escalates significant financial, contractual, supplier-performance, operational, compliance, or traveler-impact issues when senior leadership involvement is required.

• 6+ years of industry-specific experience in Procurement, Operations, or related work experience.

jobs.title: Treasury Senior Financial Analyst – Capital Markets
jobs.location: San Diego, California, United States of America
jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Incorporated
Job Area:
Finance & Accounting Group, Finance & Accounting Group > Treasury
General Summary:
The Treasury Senior Financial Analyst – Capital Markets plays a key role in supporting and executing Qualcomm’s financial risk management, global capital structure strategy, debt and liability management activities, and bank relationship analytics. This role partners closely with senior Treasury leadership to analyze credit markets, execute and manage derivatives, support debt transactions, and produce executive‑level reporting used by the Treasurer, CFO, and Finance leadership.

The position is designed for a highly analytical Treasury professional with strong capital markets fluency who can independently own complex analyses and execution workflows.

This role requires full-time onsite work in San Diego, CA (5 days per week).

This role is not eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship.

Key Responsibilities

Derivatives & Financial Risk Management
- Execute, record, and report on interest rate and FX derivatives in accordance with internal policies and external accounting requirements.
- Monitor risk exposures (rates, FX, liquidity) and summarize key drivers, sensitivities, and variances versus plan.
- Partner with Accounting to support hedge documentation, effectiveness analysis, and quarter‑end close processes.

Capital Markets & Financing
- Analyze global credit markets, interest rates, and funding conditions to support capital allocation, financing, and refinancing decisions.
- Support execution and post‑execution management of debt capital markets transactions, including: - Debt issuance
- Revolving credit facility
- Liability management and refinancing analysis
- Rate locks, interest rate swaps, and related hedging activities.

- Prepare transaction materials, scenario analysis, and economics comparisons for senior Treasury leadership and executive review.

Cash Flow Forecasting & Interest Expense Analysis
- Analyze short‑term and long‑term cash forecasts in partnership with Treasury Ops, FP&A, and business unit finance teams, supporting investment and capital structure planning.
- Support the quarterly interest expense and interest income forecast process; help explain period‑over‑period and plan variances to Treasury and Finance leadership.
- Review bi‑weekly direct cash disbursements and receipts, identifying timing, volume, and structural drivers.

Bank Relationship Analytics & Market Intelligence
- Track engagements, mandates, and activity across global banking partners; analyze bank performance and risk‑weighted‑asset return metrics.
- Support preparation of bank relationship reviews, wallet analyses, and internal scorecards.
- Monitor macroeconomic, credit market, and capital markets developments; distill implications for Qualcomm and communicate insights clearly to senior stakeholders.

AI and Automation
- Use AI-powered tools to monitor exposures, market volatility, geopolitical developments, and macroeconomic trends to support risk management decisions
- Collaborate on the introduction of automation across various Treasury processes to reduce manual work, improve controls, prevent fraud, and drive continuous process improvement

Cross‑Functional & Strategic Support
- Partner with Tax, Legal, Accounting, FP&A, and Business Units on capital markets‑related initiatives, compliance needs, and transaction execution.
- Support ad‑hoc strategic analyses for treasury leadership, including capital return programs (share repurchases, dividends) and stress/scenario analysis.

Qualifications & Experience

Required
- Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Accounting, Economics, Business, or related field.
- ~3–8 years of progressive experience in Corporate Treasury, Capital Markets, Banking, or Corporate Finance, with direct exposure to: - Debt capital markets
- Interest rate derivatives
- Cash flow forecasting and liquidity analysis.

- Strong analytical capability with advanced Excel and financial modeling skills.
- Ability to communicate complex financial concepts clearly to senior and non‑technical audiences, consistent with Senior‑level communication expectations.

Preferred
- Master’s degree (MBA or MS Finance) or professional certification (CTP, CFA).
- Experience with treasury systems, market data platforms, and bank portals.
- Exposure to hedge accounting, ASC 815 concepts, or coordination with accounting teams (supporting, not policy‑owning).
- Prior experience supporting public company debt issuance or large‑scale financing programs.
- Experience with various AI and process automation tools.

The Sourcing Specialist (Contract Manufacturing) supports CM sourcing activities, RFQ execution, supplier coordination, cost analysis, and supplier performance tracking for assigned product lines. Stakeholder Management & Communication

General Summary:
***This position is NOT eligible for Qualcomm immigration sponsorship.***
We are seeking a highly analytical and strategic  Staff Sourcing Specialist  to join the Strategic Costing & Analysis team within the Procurement organization, supporting our Datacenter and Custom Silicon business. In this role, you will develop product cost models and scenario analyses that enable accurate financial planning, inform pricing decisions, support competitive customer bids, and drive profitable growth across our Datacenter and Custom Silicon portfolio.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Product Management, Finance, Operations, Supply Chain, and Business Development teams to evaluate product cost structures, assess technology and manufacturing trade-offs, and provide actionable insights that support critical business and investment decisions. Your analyses will help establish a clear understanding of product costs, enabling the business to make informed pricing decisions, develop competitive customer proposals, and pursue growth opportunities with confidence.

This is a unique opportunity to work on cutting-edge semiconductor and datacenter technologies while influencing decisions that shape next-generation silicon, server, networking, and AI infrastructure solutions.

The ideal candidate combines strong business and financial acumen with semiconductor and datacenter industry knowledge and thrives in solving complex, ambiguous problems. They possess the analytical rigor, intellectual curiosity, and cross-functional collaboration skills required to translate complex cost drivers into actionable insights that support product planning, customer engagements, and long-term business success.

Responsibilities
- Develop and maintain product cost models, forecasts, and business scenarios to support strategic planning, customer proposals, and profitability analysis.
- Partner with Engineering, Product Management, Finance, Operations, and Supply Chain teams to evaluate product costs and identify optimization opportunities throughout the product lifecycle.
- Perform detailed cost analysis to support technology selection, product feature decisions, manufacturing strategies, and roadmap planning.
- Analyze key cost drivers across semiconductor manufacturing, packaging, test, and supply chain operations to identify risks and opportunities.
- Monitor cost performance, identify variances, and communicate recommendations to stakeholders and leadership.
- Create dashboards, reports, and presentations that translate complex data into clear business insights.
- Drive continuous improvement initiatives that enhance forecasting accuracy, reporting efficiency, and sourcing effectiveness.
- Influence and collaborate with cross-functional stakeholders to achieve business objectives, including organizing and systematizing data from many sources into a single repository.

Preferred Qualifications
- 4+ years of experience in sourcing, procurement, finance, cost engineering, business analysis, supply chain, or a related discipline.
- Experience developing financial models, cost analyses, forecasts, and business case evaluations.
- Strong organizational, analytical, and problem-solving skills with the ability to interpret complex data and make actionable recommendations.
- Advanced Excel skills, including financial modeling, pivot tables, lookups, and scenario analysis.
- Excellent verbal and written communication skills, including the ability to effectively present findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.
- Experience in the semiconductor industry, including procurement, strategic sourcing, supplier management, cost engineering, or manufacturing operations.
- Knowledge of semiconductor foundry services, SAT providers, advanced packaging, wafer fabrication, or semiconductor supply chains.
- Understanding of semiconductor cost drivers, including wafer pricing, yield impacts, packaging costs, test costs, and process technology trade-offs.
- Experience with datacenter products and infrastructure, including servers, accelerators, networking, storage, and related hardware platforms, with an understanding of the key cost drivers and economics across the datacenter ecosystem.
- Experience with business intelligence and analytics tools such as Power BI, Tableau, TM1/Cognos, or similar platforms.
- Demonstrated success working in highly collaborative, cross-functional environments.

What You'll Bring
- A passion for data-driven decision-making and continuous improvement.
- The ability to navigate ambiguity and solve complex business problems.
- Strong organization, collaboration, and influencing skills.
- A balance of strategic thinking and operational execution.
- Curiosity, ownership, and a commitment to delivering results.

jobs.title: Sourcing Specialist
jobs.location: San Diego, California, United States of America
jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Technologies, Inc.
Job Area:
Operations Group, Operations Group > Sourcing
General Summary:
Qualcomm Technologies Inc is seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Sourcing Specialist to support procurement and sourcing activities for electronic components, materials, and services required for engineering development and production programs. The successful candidate will be responsible for supplier management, purchase order execution, cost optimization, delivery performance, and cross-functional coordination with Engineering, Planning, Manufacturing, and Supplier Quality teams.

Preference will be given to candidates with experience sourcing RF components and supporting wireless, telecommunications, networking, or semiconductor-related products.

Key Responsibilities
- Manage sourcing and purchasing activities for assigned commodities and suppliers.
- Create, manage, and expedite purchase orders to ensure material availability and on-time delivery.
- Support New Product Introduction (NPI) and production requirements through proactive supplier engagement.
- Analyze demand requirements and develop procurement strategies to support business objectives.
- Negotiate pricing, lead times, and commercial terms with suppliers.
- Resolve supply, delivery, quality, and invoicing issues in a timely manner.
- Identify and mitigate material shortages, supply risks, and capacity constraints.
- Prepare spend analysis, supplier performance metrics, lead-time reporting, and other procurement-related analyses.
- Collaborate closely with Engineering, Planning, Manufacturing, Quality, and Finance teams.

Core Competencies
- Demonstrated ability to work effectively across global time zones and manage communications with suppliers and internal stakeholders in Asia, India, and other international regions.
- Flexibility to accommodate critical business discussions, supplier escalations, and project meetings outside of standard local business hours as required, typically 2 times per week.

- Effective management of priorities and responsiveness in a global, fast-paced environment.  Ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment with competing priorities and shifting business needs.
- Strong organizational and time management skills with the ability to manage a high volume of emails, supplier communications, and procurement transactions while maintaining responsiveness and accuracy.
- Advanced Microsoft Excel skills, including data analysis, reporting, pivot tables, lookups, and trend analysis.
- Strong analytical skills with the ability to interpret large data sets and make data-driven decisions with high attention to detail and accuracy.
- Supplier Relationship Management and Strategic Sourcing.
- Purchase Order Management.
- Cost Management and Cost Reduction.
- Negotiation and Influencing Skills.
- Inventory and Supply Continuity Management.  Risk Identification and Mitigation.
- Cross-Functional Collaboration with Customer Service Orientation to internal stakeholders

Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree.
OR
Associate's degree and 2+ years of Sourcing or related work experience.
OR
High School Diploma or equivalent and 4+ years of Sourcing or related work experience.

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Supply Chain, Business, Engineering, Operations Management, or related field.
- 3-7 years of procurement, sourcing, purchasing, or supply chain experience.
- Experience working with suppliers in a manufacturing, electronics, or technology environment.
- Strong negotiation and relationship management skills.
- Experience utilizing ERP/MRP systems such as Oracle, SAP, or similar platforms.
- Experience sourcing RF, wireless, networking, telecommunications, or semiconductor components.
- Knowledge of electronics manufacturing and global supply chains.
- Experience supporting engineering development programs and NPI activities.
- APICS, CPSM, or other supply chain certifications are a plus.
- Proficiency with Microsoft Excel and other Microsoft Office applications.  Strong Excel and data analysis skills, including pivot tables, lookups, reporting, and spend analysis.

- Strong analytical, organizational, and problem-solving skills.
- Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

Preferred Commodity Experience
RF / Wireless Components to include:
Power Amplifiers (PA), Low Noise Amplifiers (LNA), RF Front-End Modules (FEM), RF Filters and Duplexers, Antennas, RF Connectors and Cable Assemblies, Oscillators and Timing Devices, and Wireless Communication Modules.

Ideal Candidate Profile
The ideal candidate is a highly organized sourcing professional who can effectively manage multiple suppliers, priorities, purchase orders, and communications simultaneously. They possess strong data analysis and Excel capabilities, communicate effectively with internal stakeholders and suppliers, and have experience sourcing electronic components, with RF component experience strongly preferred. They are proactive, detail-oriented, and capable of driving results in a dynamic technology environment. The successful candidate will be comfortable working with global teams and suppliers across Asia and India and can effectively balance business requirements across multiple time zones while maintaining strong collaboration and responsiveness.

This is an office-based position located in San Diego, CA and is expected to comply with the company's onsite work policy.

This is a U.S. based position and is not eligible for visa sponsorship.

jobs.title: Senior Marketing Analyst, Investments & Operations
jobs.location: Mexico City, Distrito Federal, Mexico
jobs.description:
Company:
Qualcomm Intl Inc., Mexico Branch Office
Job Area:
Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group, Sales, Business Development & Marketing Group > Marketing Analysis
General Summary:
Are you passionate about driving strategic business decisions through financial planning, investment analysis, and operational excellence? Do you thrive in a fast-paced, global environment where you can influence multimillion-dollar marketing investments and help maximize business impact?

Qualcomm's Marketing Organization is seeking a Senior Marketing Analyst, Investments & Operations to join the Marketing Investments & Operations Management team . This highly visible role serves as a trusted business partner to marketing leaders, providing financial oversight, budget management, operational support, and investment analysis across a diverse portfolio of marketing programs and initiatives.

The successful candidate will play a critical role in ensuring marketing investments are effectively planned, managed, and optimized while providing actionable insights that support strategic decision making. This position requires strong financial acumen, analytical thinking, stakeholder management skills, and the ability to translate complex financial information into clear business recommendations.

Key Responsibilities
Budget Planning, Forecasting & Financial Management
- Partner with marketing leadership to develop annual operating plans, quarterly forecasts, and long-range strategic budgets.

- Build and maintain financial models, planning tools, and scenario analyses to support investment decisions and resource allocation.

- Prepare and manage forecast submissions through enterprise financial systems such as Oracle, SAP, or similar platforms.

- Monitor and manage departmental budgets, ensuring accuracy across monthly, quarterly, and annual financial reporting cycles.

- Provide ongoing budget oversight, including spend tracking, forecasting, variance analysis, and risk assessment.

- Develop a deep understanding of business objectives and funding requirements to ensure budget plans align with strategic priorities.

- Communicate financial performance, budget changes, and year-to-date spending trends to stakeholders through regular business reviews and executive updates.

- Serve as the primary finance liaison for marketing teams, partnering closely with corporate finance organizations and business leaders.

Marketing Operations & Spend Governance
- Oversee end-to-end financial operations, including purchase orders, approval workflows, invoice processing, vendor onboarding, and payment management.

- Partner with Procurement, Finance, Legal, and business stakeholders to ensure funding approvals, contract compliance, and accurate financial controls.

- Monitor spending trends and budget utilization, proactively identifying risks, opportunities, and areas requiring corrective action.

- Conduct monthly variance analysis to understand differences between actual expenditures and forecasted plans.

- Support accrual management, expense reclassifications, financial reconciliations, and ad hoc business analyses.

- Drive compliance with company financial policies and governance requirements while enabling efficient execution of marketing initiatives.

Investment Analysis & Business Performance
- Evaluate the effectiveness of marketing investments through ROI analysis, cost-benefit assessments, and performance measurement frameworks.

- Develop reporting and dashboards that provide visibility into marketing spend, investment efficiency, and business outcomes.

- Identify cost-saving opportunities, process efficiencies, and optimization strategies across marketing programs.

- Transform complex financial and operational data into clear, actionable insights for both financial and non-financial audiences.

- Prepare executive-level presentations, business reviews, and recommendations that support data-driven decision making.

Strategic Initiatives & Continuous Improvement
- Help shape the future of marketing investment planning, budgeting processes, and resource allocation methodologies.

- Challenge existing processes and drive innovation through automation, simplification, and best-practice implementation.

- Support strategic operations initiatives that improve planning effectiveness, operational efficiency, and business performance.

- Lead special projects and cross-functional initiatives as assigned.

- Contribute to a culture of continuous improvement and operational excellence across the Marketing organization.

What You'll Gain
As part of a lean, highly collaborative team, you will have the opportunity to work across multiple areas of the Marketing organization, gain broad exposure to senior leadership, and influence strategic investment decisions. This role offers significant visibility and the opportunity to expand your expertise in financial planning, marketing operations, business analytics, and strategic decision support.

Minimum Qualifications:
• Bachelor's degree and 2+ years of Business Administration/Management, Marketing, or related work experience.
OR
Associate's degree and 4+ years of Business Administration/Management, Marketing, or related work experience.
OR
High School Diploma or equivalent and 6+ years of Business Administration/Management, Marketing or related work experience.

*Completed advanced degrees in a relevant field may be substituted for up to two years (Master’s = one year, Doctorate = two years) of work experience.

Preferred Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in Finance, Accounting, Business Administration, Marketing, Economics, or a related field.

- 4+ years of experience in Finance, Marketing Operations, Business Planning, Accounting, or related business functions.
- Master's degree in Business Administration (MBA), Finance, Marketing, or a related field.

General Summary:
Qualcomm is a company of inventors that unlocked 5G ushering in an age of rapid acceleration in connectivity and new possibilities that will transform industries, create jobs, and enrich lives. But this is just the beginning. It takes inventive minds with diverse skills, backgrounds, and cultures to transform 5Gs potential into world-changing technologies and products. This is the Invention Age - and this is where you come in.

QCT NPI Operations Team is looking for a Staff Program Analyst in San Diego with a drive to self-succeed and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment. This role is a focal point in the organization for the management, coordination, execution and communication of all New Product Introduction (NPI) operations activities across various business units. This person will work cross-functionally with Engineers, Program Management, Business Operations, Product Marketing and other internal organizations as well as with multiple external suppliers to perform a full range of activities in support of New Product Introduction (NPI) all the way through Customer Sampling (CS) for an assigned portfolio of devices.

Key responsibilities include, but are not limited to:
- Understand the overall product lifecycle as well as the requirements to meet each key milestone.

- Generate build plans based on demand gathered from cross-functional engineering and business teams. Drive these build plans with suppliers over the course of the NPI lifecycle to meet demand.

- Identify material and hardware requirements and work with suppliers in ensuring BOMs are procured with consideration to lead time.

- Monitor critical program milestones, test HW/SW release dates, product revisions, and quality issues, communicate to suppliers as needed and minimize the impact to the overall program schedule.

- Lead Operations meetings with Program Management and other engineering & business cross-functional teams to review the status of the program and coordinate seamless planning and execution with key stakeholders.

- Identify critical paths and analyze potential changes to the program. Communicate this to the core team along with proposed mitigation and contingency plans.

- Troubleshoot supplier issues and help develop alternative schedules, milestones, processes etc. to resolve supply issues.

- Work with production teams in ensuring a smooth transition from NPI to production.
